structure.unit: Basic Property Insurance Residual Market Facility and Joint Underwriting Association

law.catch_line: When Commission may order implementation of §§ 38.2-2708 and 38.2-2709
law.text: If the Commission finds, after a reasonable period of time, that the residual market facility established by § 38.2-2702 is not creating a market that meets the purposes of this chapter, the Commission may order the implementation of §§ 38.2-2708 and 38.2-2709.
